description: Finds APRS stations heard recently within a radius (10–200 km) of the last reported position of another station given by callsign. Returns each station with callsign, type, distance (km), position (WGS84), last-heard time (UTC), speed (km/h) and comment, nearest first, excluding the centre station itself. Only stations heard within the last 30 minutes (infrastructure such as digipeaters, iGates, weather stations and objects: 24 hours) are included. The centre station must have a known position.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return (1–50, default 25).

radius_km.description: Search radius around the station in kilometres (10–200, default 50).

name: find_stations_near_station
title: Find stations near a station
